title: Exchange rates: eight business calculations
subject: Business
unit: Spring 1: The international economy and government (1.5, 1.6)
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: eight exchange-rate calculations)
intro: Lesson 28. Pounds to a foreign currency: multiply by the rate. Foreign currency to pounds: divide by the rate. Show your working.

questions.q: £1 = $1.25. A UK firm sells a coat for £120 in the USA. What is the price in dollars?
£1 = $1.25. A UK shop buys a $375 machine from the USA. What does it cost in pounds?
£1 = €1.16. A UK bakery sells a cake for £60 to a French customer. What is the price in euros?
£1 = €1.16. A Spanish supplier charges €1,160 for olive oil. What is that in pounds?
£1 = SAR 4.70 (Saudi riyal). A UK publisher sells books worth £300 to a shop in Riyadh. What is that in riyals?
£1 = SAR 4.70. A UK firm buys dates costing SAR 2,350. What is that in pounds?
£1 = ¥190 (Japanese yen). A UK firm sells a £50 kettle in Japan. What is the price in yen?
£1 = $1.25. A UK firm pays $1,000 for software. What does it cost in pounds?
